warnings: The expectation uses Landsat 8 and monitoring uses Landsat 8 and Landsat 9. Differences between sensors can register as change: in earlier tests, Sentinel-2 in monitoring but not in the expectation produced false decreases at stable sites that disappeared when both periods used the same sensors.

A 4-year expectation with Sentinel-2 is likely to exceed Earth Engine's memory limit: in tests, Sentinel-2 expectations longer than 2 years failed in the pixel inspector ("User memory limit exceeded"), and the detection-timing layers often failed as well. Use fewer expectation years or leave Sentinel-2 out of the expectation.
